import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the dataset to find the number of respondents who indicated that NFRs were not at all considered
not_considered = df['Q11_ML_NFRs_Not_Considered'].value_counts()

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who indicated that NFRs were not at all considered
proportion = not_considered['Not Relevant at All'] / len(df)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((df['Q11_ML_NFRs_Not_Considered'],), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, method='basic')

proportion, bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the dataset to find the number of respondents who indicated that NFRs were not at all considered
not_considered = df['Q11_ML_NFRs_Not_Considered'] == 'not quoted'

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who indicated that NFRs were not at all considered
proportion = not_considered.sum() / len(df)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_considered.values.astype(float),), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, method='basic')

proportion, bootstrap_result.confidence_interval
